children: Taiwan will tighten export controls on high-end AI processors and servers, mirroring U.S. rules. Traders: this may restrict NVIDIA (NVDA) component access, shipments and sales in China.
Bank of America stated that NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) captures more than 70% of AI system spending and noted the company has announced over $100 billion in buybacks.
NVIDIA (NVDA) expanded its SpaceX partnership to co-develop AI data centers plus a new server design and compute architecture for use in space and on Earth; engineering teams collaborate.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang told Bloomberg that AI market volatility is temporary, urged long-term focus on fundamentals, and said demand for NVIDIA’s AI chips remains strong.
Germany will sign a cooperation deal with NVIDIA (NVDA) to boost AI in industry, funding high-performance chips and compute for robot training, autonomous vehicles and large industrial AI models.
NVIDIA (NVDA) released three Nemotron 3.5 open-weight AI models for agentic AI. CEO Jensen Huang said AI chip orders come nearly daily and supply is rising as orders grow.
NVIDIA (NVDA) unveiled RTX Spark laptops Oct 16 with Blackwell RTX GPU + Grace CPU, up to 128GB unified memory and 1 petaflop FP4 AI performance; shares fell 0.7% to $215.70 at 9:40 a.m. ET.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang praised TSMC’s role in producing Blackwell AI chips, citing strong demand as NVIDIA scales its AI hardware lineup and ramps production.
Dan Ives of Wedbush retained an Outperform rating on NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) and kept a $300 price target, while characterizing the recent NVDA stock pullback as a potential entry point.
NVIDIA (NVDA) joined major AI firms in a Sept 29 agreement to allow independent AI audits; firms choose auditors, limit access to models/data, and audits need not be public.
